transforms.name: GrokUsageEvidence
transforms.effect: Live response_completed and turn_completed usage become canonical token contributions. No costUsd is set.

transforms.name: acceptSemantic
transforms.effect: Parses the adapter batch and stores it on the semantic plane. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: selectClaims
transforms.effect: Keeps one current claim per family key across the runtime and semantic planes. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: projectAgentMonitorState
transforms.effect: Projects AgentMonitorState from the transition basis, context, model, effort, reply, and usage. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies the projected runtime state onto the host row, applying host defaults.

transforms.name: buildUsageCostLedger
transforms.effect: Only a finite non-negative costUsd adds to the priced total. Token-only claims are skipped. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: costOf
transforms.effect: The row cost object is omitted when the ledger has no priced total.

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

defaults.when: this adapter's traced producers do not supply the row field

applicability.notes: Views listed are confirmed readers in the five shipping monitor views.

verification.notes: Declared usage=degraded. Usage requires direct ACP response/turn notifications. Journal records are excluded. signals.json and subagent progress are context occupancy, never billed burn. A subagent child’s response and turn usage, forwarded under the child sessionId, is attributed to the actor subagent_spawned names for that child_session_id. Frames a child sends before its subagent_spawned are not projected; its later turn_completed still reconciles the turn total. Captured live response_completed carries no signature or eventId; a response is identified by its session, the running native prompt (queue/changed runningPromptId or the turn’s _meta.promptId), and its ordinal within that prompt, and turn_completed reconciles the turn total. A response whose native prompt is unknown, signed or not (the 1.0.0 live shape), is not counted on its own; its turn_completed carries the whole turn total. A turn total Grok flags usageIsIncomplete is not reconciled; its response contributions stand. Turns cancelled mid-turn (session/cancel) carry no turn_completed usage; only responses completed before the cancel count. Shared path: audit/godview/contracts/cost-burn-trace.md at 25c215a2a53f363e1076210b3f6fce2155dfdc0b on audit/godview-model. Token counts without costUsd normally end in state.cost_missing, not state.cost_unavailable. The backend omits field.cost when no priced total exists. priceUsage (packages/runtime/src/services/usage-pricing.ts:19-36, 69-78) prices an upsert only from its own pricing metadata or an existing costUsd, and only looks up catalog key providerId/modelId. USAGE_PRICES (packages/runtime/src/services/usage-prices.ts:39) has 60 keys, providers anthropic and openai only. None of grok, hermes, opencode, kimi, or pi set pricing or costUsd, so the catalog is never consulted for their tokens. Grok and OpenCode are canonical, so ingress still calls priceUsage and records an unavailable estimate with no costUsd, which counts as unpriced and still yields no row total. Hermes samples are noncanonical and are not selected for pricing. Kimi writes journal usage as context, not a usage upsert. Pi emits no live usage. Priced burn flames are reachable only for claude and codex. state.cost_missing and state.burn_unpriced can occur here. state.cost_complete, state.cost_partial, state.cost_unavailable, and state.burn_flames_0 through state.burn_flames_4 cannot from these producers. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
